abstract: Immature teratoma cells obtained from a patient's ovary were cultured and morphologically characterized in the early culturing stage. The major part of the tumor was composed of neuroglial-like tissues which were surrounded by neuroepithelial-like tissues. The neuroglial-like cells cultured in vitro morphologically differentiated to the epithelioid cells and the morphologic pattern of the culture came to resemble that of the original lesion. Furthermore, some kinds of the differentiated cell grew out from the cell aggregate that grew on the colonies of the neuroglial-like cells. The morphological character of the cultured immature teratoma cells suggests that neuroglial-like cells have totipotency to change to differentiated cells forming a teratoma.
abstract_ja: 単一の患者の卵巣から得た未熟奇形腫細胞を培養し、初期培養段階で形態学的に特徴付けた。腫瘍の大部分は神経膠様組織からなり、それを神経上皮様組織が取り囲んでいた。in vitroで神経膠様細胞は上皮様細胞へ形態学的に分化し、培養の形態パターンは元の病変のものに類似するようになった。さらに、神経膠様細胞のコロニー上に生じた細胞凝集塊から、いくつかの種類の分化細胞が増殖してきた。培養された未熟奇形腫細胞の形態学的特徴から、神経膠様細胞は奇形腫を形成する分化細胞へ変化しうる全能性を有することが示唆される。
